en: “The Shorts” by Aldo, Giovanni and Giacomo
orig: “I Corti” di Aldo, Giovanni e Giacomo
ov: I Corti ("Shorts") by Aldo, Giovanni & Giacomo was the first stage show of the comedy trio, with the participation of Marina Massironi. It was recorded live at the Teatro Nuovo in Ferrara on 28 and 29 March 1996. Produced by Agidi, with the theatre direction of Arturo Brachetti.
